name: Azariah
bio:
Azariah (also called Uzziah), son of Amaziah, was made king of Judah at sixteen by the people of Judah after his father was assassinated at Lachish. He rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah (2 Kings 14:21-22).

## 📖 Core Story: Fifty-Two Years, and a Lifelong Leprosy

Azariah reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem, doing right in the LORD's eyes as his father Amaziah had, though the high places remained. The LORD struck him with leprosy, and he lived in a separate house for the rest of his life while his son Jotham governed the people as regent. Azariah was buried with his ancestors in the City of David, and Jotham succeeded him (2 Kings 15:1-7).
